pt.h: Parque de quase 1.600 acres nos penhascos e ravinas do rio Big Sioux, na borda noroeste de Sioux City, Iowa, com vista para a divisa com Dakota do Sul. Fica perto do extremo norte das Loess Hills.
pt.ff: Transição de penhascos de argila e pradaria para morros de rocha e floresta de carvalho-bur. Iúcas, penstêmons e anêmonas-pulsátilas; perus selvagens, veados, coiotes, raposas e corujas. Rochas do Cretáceo ricas em fósseis marinhos.

en.r: Stone State Park is a state park in Iowa, United States. It covers 5.8 km² and has been protected since 1935. It is managed by the state government.
en.h: A park of almost 1,600 acres in the bluffs and ravines of the Big Sioux River on the north-west edge of Sioux City, Iowa, overlooking the South Dakota border. It lies near the northern end of the Loess Hills.
en.ff: A transition from clay bluffs and prairie to rock hills and bur oak forest. Yucca, penstemon and pasque flower; wild turkeys, deer, coyotes, red foxes and barred owls. Cretaceous bedrock rich in marine fossils.

es.h: Parque de casi 1.600 acres en los riscos y barrancos del río Big Sioux, en el borde noroeste de Sioux City, Iowa, con vista al límite con Dakota del Sur. Está cerca del extremo norte de las Loess Hills.
es.ff: Transición de riscos de arcilla y pradera a cerros de roca y bosque de roble bur. Yucas, penstemones y anémonas pulsátilas; pavos salvajes, ciervos, coyotes, zorros y búhos. Rocas del Cretácico ricas en fósiles marinos.

pt.h: Floresta estadual de 944 acres no condado de Dubuque, Iowa, perto de Luxemburg; 712 acres são Marco Natural Nacional e reserva estadual. Seria o único bosque antigo de pinheiros-brancos que resta em Iowa.
pt.ff: Encostas voltadas ao norte com fendas de ar frio, em carste de dolomita com dolinas e cavernas, na Driftless Area; os pinheiros podem ser relíquia de um clima mais frio.

en.r: White Pine Hollow State Forest is a state forest in Iowa, United States. It has been protected since 1934.
en.h: A 944-acre state forest in Dubuque County, Iowa, near Luxemburg; 712 acres are a National Natural Landmark and state preserve. It is said to hold Iowa's only remaining old-growth white pines.
en.ff: North-facing algific talus slopes in dolomite karst with sinkholes and caverns, in the Driftless Area; the pines may be a relic of a colder climate.

es.r: El White Pine Hollow State Forest es un bosque estatal en Iowa, Estados Unidos. Está protegido desde 1934.
es.h: Bosque estatal de 944 acres en el condado de Dubuque, Iowa, cerca de Luxemburg; 712 acres son Hito Natural Nacional y reserva estatal. Sería el único bosque antiguo de pinos blancos que queda en Iowa.
es.ff: Laderas orientadas al norte con grietas de aire frío, en karst de dolomita con dolinas y cavernas, en la Driftless Area; los pinos pueden ser reliquia de un clima más frío.
